title: Number of Ways to Paint N×3 Grid
statement:
You have a `n x 3` grid. You want to paint all `3*n` cells with different colors. The available colors are: 1 (Red), 2 (Green), 3 (Blue), and 4 (Yellow). You can only use 3 colors, meaning you use a subset of size 3 from the above 4 colors for each row.
Each cell must be painted such that no two adjacent cells (horizontally or vertically) share the same color.
Return the number of ways to paint the grid. Since the answer can be huge, return it modulo `10^9 + 7`.

examples.explanation: 12 ways to paint a single row with 3 adjacent cells using 3 colors (no two adjacent same).
